comparison_reference_format: byte_comparison_ref addresses byte_comparisons by SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators; records bind full source/head/dev blob identities, content hashes and exact changed-symbol evidence.
evidence_policy: Exact byte/mode equality is evidence only for the identified version/path. A whole differing file is never declared covered from filename, ancestry, preserved location, test names or a replacement PR.

Changed Python symbols use exact source text hashes, including decorators. Matching symbols are partial evidence; module-level code, differing symbols, removals and integration semantics remain unresolved.

foreground.next_queue: After eligible once-only apply/verify outcomes are recorded, continue existing queued Mu. Individually unsafe targets and useful-work owners remain open under this cleanup task.
